[[File:Chapter1.png|thumb|300px|Chapter 1: Awakening - Cover]] '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is the 1st chapter of ''[[LIMBO]]''. It is followed by the succeeding chapter, [[Lake Passage]]. ==Walkthrough== As the setting fades in to reveal the nameless boy sleeping on the ground, the boy wakes up in the midst of Limbo world. Proceed forth toward the edge of the tree branch, and drop yourself down the cliff where the inclined slope safely lets you slide down. Beware of the deadly obstacle: jump over the spiky hole to avoid impaling yourself. Then move to cross the next checkpoint/chapter. ==Traps and obstacles== *Spiked ground ==Hidden Egg== [[File:Egg1.png|thumb|300px|Egg #1]] The hidden egg is found right at the start of the game. Move to the leftmost part of the game and obtain the egg on the paddle. This gains the "Wrong Way" [[Limbo: Achievements/Trophies|achievement]].
